scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: if [ -x ./scripts/worktree.sh ]; then ./scripts/worktree.sh setup; elif [ -n "${T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -x "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/worktree.sh" ]; then "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/worktree.sh" setup; fi

scripts.name: Clean Worktree Build
scripts.command: if [ -x ./scripts/worktree.sh ]; then ./scripts/worktree.sh clean; elif [ -n "${T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -x "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/worktree.sh" ]; then "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/worktree.sh" clean; fi
